column1: # MEASURED on Apple M5 Max / 128 GB / macOS 26.4 / MLX 0.32.1 / mtplx 2.10.1,
# NOT MEASURED ON A 64 GB MACHINE.
# need_mib is the server process tree's resident size at the profile's own
# context, taken by the installer's smoke test: 29,303 MiB, rounded up for
# margin. This model is DENSE, so every weight is touched and RSS is a fair
# proxy for what it needs -- 28.6 GiB against 27.9 GB of weights, the balance
# being the KV cache. That does NOT hold for the MoE pack; see its
#   profile     ctx      measured RSS   decode        effective   ttft
#   fast         65536   EXTRAPOLATED -- half the KV, so ~14 GiB less; NOT MEASURED
# `coding` is the row with a measured session behind it. `fast` halves the
# context to buy headroom on a smaller machine; its sizing is arithmetic, not a
# measurement, and it is labelled so.
